palette.notes: Code: palette_size 49 on the still, 3 ramps, median hue shift 11.7 over 17 colours. Each scene has a narrow mood palette: orange-red sunset, cyan-green sky, sickly green bed, red/blue neon bar, amber skyline, navy night with orange window light. Shadows go to deep navy/purple, lights to warm orange.

lighting: Strong single motivated light per scene: sunset sky, window glow, neon sign, lit cafe at night, street lamps, a monitor in a dark room. Darks dominate; the light source is the focal point.
silhouette: Small human figures (girl on a train seat, person on a bed from above, silhouette at a bar, figure outside a cafe) read as simple shapes against bright backgrounds; often seen from behind or in silhouette.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 66.7 ms (on twos), 6.74 drawings/s, 116 changes in 17.21 s: mostly still scenes with small ambient loops (clouds, lights) on twos.

texture: Clean pixel clusters, little dithering (dither_share 0.0015); dense detail in props, soft gradients in skies.
camera: Montage of about 9 scenes cut every 1.5-2 s; varied angles (street level, train interior, top-down bed, wide cafe at night). Some scenes hold for two sheet frames with a slight drift (skyline, park).

acting.enters: Characters are already placed in each scene; they are small and passive.
acting.acts: Barely act: sit, lie, stand; the mood comes from light and setting.
acting.depth: People are small in the mid-ground or in silhouette in the foreground; environments carry the frame.

techniques: one motivated light source per scene (neon, window, lamp)
dark navy shadows with warm orange lights
small characters in big environments for mood
silhouette figure against a bright bar
fast vignette montage, ~1.5 s per scene
feel: dark navy world + one warm light per scene + tiny passive figures + 1.5 s cuts = cozy lofi longing
for_fred: Put Fred small in a big dark scene lit by one warm light (a lamp or a screen) and let him just sit there for a beat before acting; the cut to a different lit scene does the work instead of extra animation.
